sop_name: Arrest Procedure under the NDPS Act
objective: To ensure lawful arrest, documentation and production of accused persons in accordance with the NDPS Act, 1985 and the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC).

legal_basis.purpose: Power to issue warrants and authorizations for arrest.
Power to arrest based on prior information in specified places.
Power to arrest in public places.
Mandatory report of arrest and seizure.

procedure.title: Establish Legal Grounds
procedure.description: Confirm that reasonable grounds exist for arrest under the NDPS Act.

procedure.title: Identify the Officer
procedure.description: The arresting officer shall identify themselves and disclose their authority.

procedure.title: Inform the Accused
procedure.description: Inform the accused of the grounds of arrest and applicable provisions of law.

procedure.title: Conduct Personal Search
procedure.description: Where applicable, conduct personal search in accordance with Section 50 of the NDPS Act.

procedure.title: Prepare Arrest Memo
procedure.description: Prepare an arrest memo containing the date, time, location, witnesses and signatures.

procedure.title: Seize Relevant Evidence
procedure.description: Secure narcotic substances, digital devices, documents and other material connected to the offence.

procedure.title: Medical Examination
procedure.description: Arrange medical examination whenever required under applicable law.

procedure.title: Produce Before Magistrate
procedure.description: Produce the arrested person before the competent Magistrate within the legally prescribed period.

procedure.title: Submit Report
procedure.description: Forward arrest and seizure report to the immediate superior officer in accordance with Section 57.

rights_of_accused: To be informed of the grounds of arrest.
To be produced before a Magistrate within the prescribed legal period.
To consult a legal practitioner as permitted by law.
To receive a copy of the arrest memo.
